title: Agent identity / delegation — Splunk hunt (schema 1.8.0)
schema.name: agentsec.security_event
schema_version_note: LAB-MCP-001 Q-MCP-*.spl does not filter schema.version and is 1.8.0-compatible. This hunt is schema-version agnostic in SPL. Q-MCP-DELEGATION is NOT APPLICABLE (CTRL-DELEGATION-001 / ambient_deputy).

queries.security_question: For this run: who called whom, what authority was claimed, what privileged operation was requested, what did CTRL-MCP-001 decide, and was execution observed?

queries_not_created.reason: Caller vs callee is first-class on Q-AGENT-DELEGATION-AUTHORITY. Q-MCP-WHO already lists principal + gen_ai.agent.id (callee) with a documented extra IDENTITY row.
claim.trust, claimed_scope, and identity_claim_hash are columns on Q-AGENT-DELEGATION-AUTHORITY.
CTRL-IDENTITY-001 OBSERVE is already a Q-MCP-AUTHZ row plus the identity_* columns on the new hunt.
REUSED: Q-MCP-TOOL, Q-MCP-EXECUTED, and execution_observation on Q-AGENT-DELEGATION-AUTHORITY.
NOT APPLICABLE. That hunt requires CTRL-DELEGATION-001 / ambient_deputy (MCP-006). A2A-001 uses CTRL-IDENTITY-001. Do not rewrite Q-MCP-DELEGATION for this lab.

detection.note: Reused unchanged. DET-A2A and DET-DELEGATION not created. Overlay reason is LAB-ONLY, not a production IOC.
